mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle, raising borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% indicates weakening labor market conditions, dampening economic growth prospects and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE rises above 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices above 2% in the same month signal robust economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase by >2% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase by >2% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion phases, a sharp drop in demand metrics (HOUST) exceeding 5% in a month signals overvaluation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Regime: late-cycle expansion; HOUST falls >5% in a month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansions when HOUST falls >5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above baseline levels reflects strong labor market confidence, boosting consumer spending and corporate investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both demand (RSAFS) and overall demand (GDPC1) indices above 3% in the same quarter indicate robust economic activity, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both RSAFS and GDPC1 rise by >3% in the same quarter
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS and GDPC1 both rise by >3% in the same quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate above 1% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% in the same month signals aggressive monetary tightening, elevating risk premiums and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >1% and CPIAUCSL rises >0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during inflationary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises >1% and CPIAUCSL rises >0.5% in the same month.
